name: Fondo de Protección Ambiental: Proyectos Sustentables para Pueblos Indígenas

funder.name: Ministerio del Medio Ambiente de Chile

summary: Annual Chilean environment ministry contest giving 6 million pesos to registered Indigenous communities and associations for projects that protect their natural surroundings, with biodiversity conservation as one of five thematic lines.
